lines: Stand clear of the <wavy>heat</wavy>. A forge forgives less than I do.
Give the forge room. Armor works better without elbows in it.
Step carefully near the forge. I would rather greet you than patch you up.
There you are. I was just near the forge, trying to keep the day sensible.
Mind the heat. The forge has no manners today.
Good timing. I was checking straps before the day found teeth.
Stand clear of the anvil unless you came to learn patience loudly.
Hello. If you smell smoke, that is the work behaving normally.
Keep your sleeves back. Hot metal makes quick decisions.
You caught me between hammer strikes. Speak while the iron waits.
Come in carefully. Everything here is either heavy, hot, or judging me.
Morning. I have sparks, dents, and a little time.
If you need armor, say so before the next plate cools.
Good to see someone walking in without fresh holes in their gear.
The forge is loud, but I am listening.
Step around the quench bucket. It has surprised better feet than yours.
Hello there. The metal is behaving, which is more than I can say for most days.
Keep clear of the tongs and tell me what you need.
I have a few moments before the next piece needs the hammer.
